verdict.summary: RT16 closes the RT15 path/pyc escape and replaces the local D9 oracle with actual authenticated D9 v1.13 execution. It is nevertheless rejected for three verifier-boundary defects: the returned EP8 adapter closes over the entire FrozenAuthority and therefore retains the exact D9 and rejected RT14 objects it claims to quarantine; the adapter omits three of the nine EP8 callables required by the preserved RT13 semantic source while adding two non-authoritative exports; and the v1.10 loader makes Authority cease to be a frozen dataclass by replacing its exact decorator with an identity function.

blockingFindings.claimUnderTest: verifiedSemanticRtApiContract.returnedSnapshot.mustNotRetain and objectGraphRule, plus the author adjudication's returnedSnapshotConstruction.quarantines and activeProof, require the returned VerifiedSemanticRTSnapshotV1 to make D9 modules/bytes/review and the rejected RT14 contextual overlay unreachable.
blockingFindings.finding: The returned adapter retains ordinary EP8 function objects. Each function exposes the EP8 module globals; the global load_json and module-lookup lambdas close directly over the live FrozenAuthority instance. From snapshot.ep8.check.__globals__['load_json'].__closure__, the reviewer recovered that authority and reached, by object identity, the exact D9 v1.13 module, D9 artifact bytes, D9 review object, and rejected RT14 overlay. The authored _snapshot_quarantine_findings nevertheless returned an empty list because it checks only direct global values and does not traverse function closure cells or the reachable object graph.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is the exact forbidden capability flow RT16 says it repaired. A direct closure path to FrozenAuthority also defeats the declared opacity and immutability boundary, since its parsed and module maps are mutable and its complete 47-buffer map is reachable. Direct-id inspection is not an object-graph proof.
requiredRepair: Construct the returned adapter without any callable, default, closure cell, global, container, descriptor, or back-reference that can reach FrozenAuthority, D9, RT14, or the complete verifier buffer map.
Make the returned capability hold only the exact EP8-only immutable module/data closure it requires, not lambdas closing over the verifier owner.

Replace the shallow quarantine check with a cycle-safe recursive reachability oracle covering function globals, closures, defaults, bound owners, mapping/container contents, slots, and module dictionaries; independently falsify every forbidden edge.

blockingFindings.claimUnderTest: The exact preserved RT13 semantic basis declares capabilityClosure.source.requiredCheckerApi as the EP validation/derivation consumer authority, and RT16 says the returned snapshot retains a verified EP8 pure validation/derivation adapter.
blockingFindings.finding: RT13 requires nine exact callable names. RT16's VerifiedEP8Adapter exposes only six of them, omitting derive_transitive_requirements, encode_semantic_object_binding, and resolve_semantic_object_bindings. It instead exposes _open_test_project_store and check, neither of which is in the preserved requiredCheckerApi; the former is an underscored test-store construction helper rather than part of the declared pure consumer surface. getattr on each omitted required name raises AttributeError. The checker never compares its hard-coded eight-name allowlist to the preserved RT13 authority and never invokes the returned adapter.

activeProbe.underlyingAuthenticatedClosureControl: PASS: all nine required EP8 callables executed after EP8/EP7/EP6 caches were reset and cwd was changed; exact module identities were restored, all results matched, no repository-local path or pyc was opened, and all 47 outer read counts remained exactly one.

blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The returned capability is the implementation contract consumed downstream. Preserving the semantic basis while dropping three of its declared operations creates a week-one API fork and makes the exact retained-surface claim false. The successful underlying control proves this is an RT16 adapter-construction defect, not an EP8 limitation.
requiredRepair: Derive the adapter allowlist mechanically from the exact frozen RT13 requiredCheckerApi rather than restating it.
Expose exactly those nine pure validation/derivation callables and no test helper or whole-contract checker unless a new binding contract explicitly requires them.

Invoke every returned adapter method through the returned object after delayed cache reset, with the filesystem and ambient-module surfaces poisoned, and require exact read-count and reachability closure.

blockingFindings.claimUnderTest: The assigned interposition acceptance criterion permits exact single-fire dependency binding but forbids semantic-source transformation; RT16 also describes bottom-up exact-buffer execution of the D9 lineage and every retained source compiling from its exact authenticated buffer.
blockingFindings.finding: Five declared D9 interpositions inject already-authenticated predecessor authority at eager assignment seams. The sixth is different: at check-d9-v1.10.py's @dataclass(frozen=True) line it replaces the standard dataclass decorator with a passthrough identity function. Exact-source baseline execution yields a frozen dataclass Authority with a seven-parameter generated initializer; RT16's executed module yields a non-dataclass Authority with the empty object constructor, and valid Authority construction fails. The selector is exact and unique, fires once, restores once, and compiles unmodified source bytes, but its runtime effect is an observable semantic rewrite rather than dependency binding.

If exact v1.10 module execution remains necessary, choose a reviewed execution mechanism that preserves the frozen dataclass and all public behavior; do not use an identity decorator.
Add a before/after semantic probe for every interposed target, not only selector/fire/restore receipts.

acceptanceResults.evidence: All nine predeclared semantic roots, rawObjectResolutionConformance, pureCallSignatures, and the four protected semanticOwnershipBoundary fields are recursively exact to RT15. Independent byte-first recomputation reproduces both fixtures and all nine LeaseStateV3 scenarios.

47 declared names resolve to 47 unique paths; every content read count is exactly one; all pins match before source execution; all 47 individual pin corruptions reject with zero verified-source callbacks; end stat identities and artifacts/__pycache__ state remain unchanged. Audit observed exactly one open for each frozen input during freeze and no pyc or unexpected repository-local executable/data read.

The 13-member EP8 source/data closure resolves from authenticated buffers and all nine authoritative callables execute after delayed cache reset with zero local reads. RT16 fails only when it packages that sound closure into the returned eight-name adapter and retains authority-closing lambdas.

The exact six RT14 call shapes derive from the frozen consumer AST. Actual authenticated v1.13 exports execute across all sixteen rows: direct derive_class was observed 33 times, derive_codes 16, reduce_concurrent once, and check once; V17.V16.derive_class was reached explicitly for every row and 194 times total including transitive retained-checker calls. Twenty independent noncallable, wrong-result, wrong-arity and raising export poisons all failed the compatibility gate; no checker-local classifier or code-map reducer exists.

All six selectors are unique, exact-AST-bound, single-fire, and single-restore. The five predecessor/bootstrap assignments preserve their selected source semantics. The v1.10 decorator interposition deliberately changes Authority from a frozen dataclass to a plain class and therefore fails the no-transform requirement.

Authored normal and selftest modes pass under python3 -I -B: 40 exact mutations, 132 raw-resolution adversarials, 36 lease-shape adversarials, 48 hostile shapes and 25 authored trust/D9 falsifiers reject. These inspected paths do not traverse function closures, derive the adapter surface from RT13, or preserve v1.10 dataclass behavior, so they do not cure the three blockers.

nonBlockingObservations.text: Noncallable, wrong-result and wrong-arity D9 poisons become controlled findings. A callable that raises RuntimeError aborts _d9_compatibility_findings rather than returning a finding. This still fails closed and the exact pinned D9 module is not caller-controlled, so it is not a separate acceptance blocker; a successor should include Exception-to-finding containment if the compatibility helper is itself claimed total under active mutation.

The v1.10 Authority class is not in that contract's four-name required public export set, and actual v1.13 consumer behavior independently passed. The interposition finding is blocking because the assigned and declared execution boundary forbids semantic transformation, not because the reviewer observed a wrong D9 class/code result.
